values.content:
description: "Recover from Primary Region Failure"
schemaVersion: "0.3"
parameters:
  SecondaryInstanceId:
    type: String
    description: "The ID of the secondary instance to start"
  SecondaryRegion:
    type: String
    description: "The region of the secondary instance"
  EndpointGroupArn:
    type: String
    description: "The ARN of the Global Accelerator Endpoint Group to update"

mainSteps:
  - name: StartSecondaryInstance
    action: "aws:changeInstanceState"
    inputs:
      InstanceIds:
        - "{{ SecondaryInstanceId }}"
      DesiredState: "running"
      CheckStateOnly: false
    isEnd: false

  - name: WaitForInstanceRunning
    action: "aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty"
    inputs:
      Service: "ec2"
      Api: "describeInstanceStatus"
      PropertySelector: "$.InstanceStatuses[0].InstanceState.Name"
      DesiredValues:
        - "running"
      InstanceIds:
        - "{{ SecondaryInstanceId }}"
    isEnd: false

  - name: UpdateGlobalAcceleratorWeight
    action: "aws:executeScript"
    inputs:
      Runtime: "python3.8"
      Handler: "script_handler"
      InputPayload:
        EndpointGroupArn: "{{ EndpointGroupArn }}"
        InstanceId: "{{ SecondaryInstanceId }}"
      Script: |
        import boto3
        
        def script_handler(events, context):
            ga = boto3.client('globalaccelerator')
            endpoint_group_arn = events['EndpointGroupArn']
            instance_id = events['InstanceId']
            
            # Update the endpoint group to set weight to 100 for the secondary instance
            # Note: We need to preserve other settings if any, but here we just update the specific endpoint
            
            response = ga.update_endpoint_group(
                EndpointGroupArn=endpoint_group_arn,
                EndpointConfigurations=[
                    {
                        'EndpointId': instance_id,
                        'Weight': 100,
                        'ClientIPPreservationEnabled': True
                    }
                ]
            )
            return {'Status': 'Updated'}
    isEnd: true
values.name: CloudSleuth-Recovery-Workflow
